name: Widow
ability: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.
setup: Storyteller marks one good player with the KNOWS reminder (global reminder).
wakes: First night only (or the first night they are the Widow).
interaction: Sees the whole Grimoire, then chooses a player who is poisoned. The KNOWS good player wakes and is shown the Widow token.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when choosing, the chosen player is not poisoned while that lasts. The good player still learns a Widow is in play. Poison ends when the Widow dies.

jinxes.text: An Alchemist-Widow has no Widow ability & a Widow is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Widow may publicly guess a living player as the Widow. If correct, the Demon must choose the Widow tonight.
If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
When the Widow sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Widow does not see the Grimoire.

rulings.text: The poison lasts until the Widow dies, then the player becomes healthy.
The Widow sees the Grimoire only once.
A Widow created later (e.g. by Pit-Hag on night 3) acts that night, and a good player learns a Widow is in play.

test_scenarios.name: poison and knows
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Widow, Bob Fortune Teller, Carol Empath (KNOWS), Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Alice sees the Grimoire, chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob poisoned; Carol is shown the Widow token.

test_scenarios.name: poison ends on death
test_scenarios.expected: Bob healthy; Bob's info is truthful from then on.

test_scenarios.name: widow drunk
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Widow, Frank Sailor (chooses Alice night 1, Alice drunk), Bob Empath, Carol Chef (KNOWS).
test_scenarios.expected: Bob not poisoned that night; Carol still shown the Widow.

test_scenarios.name: poppy grower jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Widow, Gina Poppy Grower alive.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice does not see the Grimoire but still chooses a player to poison.

test_scenarios.name: magician jinx
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Widow, Hank Magician, Dave Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Imp and Magician tokens are removed from Alice's view.
